timeline.summary: Q1FY27 (Aug 14, 2026): Gyftr reported consolidated revenue of ₹155.3 Cr (down 48% QoQ) and PAT of ₹5.28 Cr, with the auditor issuing a qualified conclusion over the ₹2,122.40 lakh Kingfisher Finvest borrowings and a ₹2,500 lakh garnishee order.
Gyftr Ltd disclosed proposed related-party transactions of ₹2,500 Cr with Vouchagram India Pvt Ltd for FY26-27, seeking shareholder approval at AGM on Sept 29, 2026.

Gyftr Ltd’s 42nd AGM on September 29, 2026, elected **Mr. Arvind Prabhakar** as Chairperson via remote voting, with **Mr. Umesh Aggarwal** proposing and **Ms. Meenu Aggarwal** seconding the nomination.
Gyftr Ltd’s 42nd AGM (Sep 29, 2026) unanimously approved standalone/consolidated financials for FY2026 and reappointed Mr. Arvind Prabhakar (DIN: 05232758) as director.
Gyftr Limited completed the alteration of its MOA object clause on October 26, 2026, to include software development and SaaS solutions.
